archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY + MODERN CLINICAL TEAL/EMERALD (Care, Trust, Vitality)

typography.notes: Outfit delivers human warmth + high precision geometry for veterinary care headlines; DM Sans provides ultra-readable body text for Brazilian Portuguese pet owners.

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand value proposition + emergency badge + CTA left, dynamic pet care showcase badge & real veterinary photo right
entry_surfaces./servicos: clinical services catalog — filterable tabbed grid with transparent pricing, duration & direct booking hooks
entry_surfaces./veterinarios: medical team directory — rich profile cards with CRMV licenses, specialties, and bio modals
entry_surfaces./sobre: editorial narrative — clinic values, modern surgical facilities, timeline, mission and trust credentials
entry_surfaces./contato: contact hub — interactive location map card, emergency hotline, WhatsApp direct button, message form
entry_surfaces./agendamentos: stepped booking flow — interactive service picker, veterinary preference, live calendar slot selector, pet info, instant visual confirmation
entry_surfaces./admin/login: branded administrative gate — clinic management sign-in with security badge and demo quick-fill
entry_surfaces./admin: clinic command center — appointment triage board (pendente/confirmado/cancelado/concluído), quick stats, filterable schedule

layouts.header: Sticky crystal glass header with brand mark (Instituto Vida Animal), 6 desktop navigation links, emergency WhatsApp quick pill, and 'Agendar Consulta' CTA button. Responsive hamburger sheet for mobile.
layouts.footer: Deep emerald/teal inverse footer (#042F2E) with CRMV credentials, emergency 24h notice, opening hours (Seg-Sáb 08h-20h, Plantão 24h), quick links, address in São Paulo/SP, and WhatsApp button.
layouts.bento_features: Tetris-style asymmetric grid for clinic differentiators: 24h emergency unit, in-house laboratory, surgical center, certified grooming spa, cat-friendly exclusive area.
layouts.admin_layout: High-density dashboard with summary KPI cards (Total Agendamentos, Pendentes, Confirmados Hoje, Concluídos), status filter pills, search bar, and action status dropdowns.

motion_guidelines.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with prefers-reduced-motion checks or subtle opacity-only transitions.

accessibility_and_locale.test_attributes: All forms, inputs, buttons, filter pills, status selects, and modals MUST feature explicit 'data-testid' attributes (e.g. data-testid='booking-submit-btn', data-testid='service-card-cirurgia', data-testid='admin-status-select').

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace the amateur website look with an authentic, high-end veterinary clinic portal for 'Instituto Vida Animal'.

Update /frontend/src/index.css to import '@fontsource-variable/outfit' and '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans', set --font-heading: 'Outfit Variable', sans-serif, and configure deep teal/emerald clinical theme tokens.
Ensure all 6 public pages (Início, Serviços, Veterinários, Sobre, Contato, Agendamentos) and the Admin area (/admin, /admin/login) are fully implemented and connected to FastAPI backend routes.

Provide realistic seed data via backend/seed.py for services (Banho & Tosa, Consulta Geral, Vacinação, Emergência 24h, Cirurgia, Exames), veterinarians (with CRMV-SP credentials), and initial appointment records.
Form inputs must support Brazilian phone masking '(XX) XXXXX-XXXX' and Brazilian Portuguese validation messages.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when appointments are booked or status updated.
Admin dashboard must allow switching status between 'pendente', 'confirmado', 'concluído', 'cancelado' with instantaneous visual feedback.
Include an emergency 24h floating/top alert with immediate call and WhatsApp trigger for urgent pet care.
